<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto&family=Open+Sans&display=swap');

    font-family: Garamond, serif !important;
    font-size: 1.4rem !important;
    font-style: italic !important;

    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
  }

    left: 0;

<!-- Replace YOUR_IMAGE_URL_1/2/3 with relative image paths (e.g. images/card1.jpeg).        -->
<!-- Replace Card Title and body text for each card.                                          -->
<!-- To add more cards: copy one <div> block (the outer <div> wrapping fc-card + fc-hint)    -->
<!-- and increment the id (fc-card-3, fc-card-4, ...). No other changes needed.              -->
```{=html}
<style>
  .fc-wrap { display: flex; gap: 1.2em; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem 0; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; }
  .fc-card { width: 220px; height: 220px; perspective: 1000px; cursor: pointer; }
  .fc-inner { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 0.55s ease; border-radius: 12px; }
  .fc-card.flipped .fc-inner { transform: rotateY(180deg); }
  .fc-front, .fc-back { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; backface-visibility: hidden; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; }
  .fc-front { background: #1C2944; }
  .fc-front img { width: 100%; height: 70%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
  .fc-front-label { color: white; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.8em 1em; text-align: center; }
  .fc-back { background: #f0f2f5; border: 2px solid #1C2944; transform: rotateY(180deg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 1.2em; box-sizing: border-box; }
  .fc-back-title { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1C2944; margin: 0 0 0.5em 0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
  .fc-back-body { font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #444; margin: 0; }
  .fc-hint { text-align: center; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #aaa; margin-top: 0.4em; }
</style>

<div class="fc-wrap">

  <div>
    <div class="fc-card" id="fc-card-0">
      <div class="fc-inner">
        <div class="fc-front">
          <img src="<!-- YOUR_IMAGE_URL_1 e.g. images/card1.jpeg -->" alt="<!-- IMAGE DESCRIPTION -->"/>
          <div class="fc-front-label"><!-- CARD TITLE 1 --></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fc-back">
          <p class="fc-back-title"><!-- CARD TITLE 1 --></p>
          <p class="fc-back-body"><!-- BACK TEXT FOR CARD 1 --></p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="fc-hint">click to flip</p>
  </div>

  <div>
    <div class="fc-card" id="fc-card-1">
      <div class="fc-inner">
        <div class="fc-front">
          <img src="<!-- YOUR_IMAGE_URL_2 e.g. images/card2.jpeg -->" alt="<!-- IMAGE DESCRIPTION -->"/>
          <div class="fc-front-label"><!-- CARD TITLE 2 --></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fc-back">
          <p class="fc-back-title"><!-- CARD TITLE 2 --></p>
          <p class="fc-back-body"><!-- BACK TEXT FOR CARD 2 --></p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="fc-hint">click to flip</p>
  </div>

  <div>
    <div class="fc-card" id="fc-card-2">
      <div class="fc-inner">
        <div class="fc-front">
          <img src="<!-- YOUR_IMAGE_URL_3 e.g. images/card3.jpeg -->" alt="<!-- IMAGE DESCRIPTION -->"/>
          <div class="fc-front-label"><!-- CARD TITLE 3 --></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fc-back">
          <p class="fc-back-title"><!-- CARD TITLE 3 --></p>
          <p class="fc-back-body"><!-- BACK TEXT FOR CARD 3 --></p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="fc-hint">click to flip</p>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('.fc-card').forEach(function (card) {
    card.addEventListener('click', function () {
      card.classList.toggle('flipped');
    });
  });
});
</script>
```

<!-- For a tabbed display, use the following code. Like the above, more HTML coding is required here, but it is fairly simple once you know what to look for. Ignore the <style> component - anything you need to edit is in the <div> sections. -->

```{=html}
<div style="font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; border: 1px solid #dde3ec; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto;">

  <div style="display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid #dde3ec;">
    <button id="tbtn-0" onclick="switchTab(0)" style="flex:1; padding: 1.6em 1em; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; background: white; color: #1C2944; border: none; border-right: 1px solid #dde3ec; border-bottom: 3px solid #1C2944;">Social</button>
    <button id="tbtn-1" onclick="switchTab(1)" style="flex:1; padding: 1.6em 1em; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; background: #f0f2f5; color: #999; border: none; border-right: 1px solid #dde3ec; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;">Biological</button>
    <button id="tbtn-2" onclick="switchTab(2)" style="flex:1; padding: 1.6em 1em; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; background: #f0f2f5; color: #999; border: none; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;">Psychological</button>
  </div>

  <div id="tab-0" style="display:block; padding: 2em 2.2em; background: white;">
    <p style="font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #333; margin: 0 0 1em 0;"><strong style="color:#1C2944;">Social risk factors</strong> for the development of mental illness or mental health deterioration can include:</p>
    <ul style="font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #333; padding-left: 1.4em; margin: 0;">
    <!-- These are list items, or bullet points-->
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Lack of social support and/or isolation from others</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Abusive relationships</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Weak social safety net (family and community factors)</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Low socioeconomic status</li>
      <li>Exposure to discrimination</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div id="tab-1" style="display:none; padding: 2em 2.2em; background: white;">
    <p style="font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #333; margin: 0 0 1em 0;"><strong style="color:#1C2944;">Biological risk factors</strong> for the development of mental illness or mental health deterioration can include:</p>
    <ul style="font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #333; padding-left: 1.4em; margin: 0;">
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Genetic vulnerability</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Health comorbidities (or generally poor physical health)</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Poor nutrition or sleep patterns</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Neurological deficits or injuries</li>
      <li>Substance abuse</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div id="tab-2" style="display:none; padding: 2em 2.2em; background: white;">
    <p style="font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #333; margin: 0 0 1em 0;"><strong style="color:#1C2944;">Psychological risk factors</strong> for the development of mental illness or mental health deterioration can include:</p>
    <ul style="font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #333; padding-left: 1.4em; margin: 0;">
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Prolonged exposure to stress</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Traumatic experience(s)</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Dissatisfaction with current life status</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:0.5em;">Self-depreciation</li>
      <li>Certain personality traits, thoughts, emotions, and attitudes</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
function switchTab(idx) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('tbtn-' + i);
    const panel = document.getElementById('tab-' + i);
    if (i === idx) {
      btn.style.background = 'white';
      btn.style.color = '#1C2944';
      btn.style.borderBottom = '3px solid #1C2944';
      panel.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      btn.style.background = '#f0f2f5';
      btn.style.color = '#999';
      btn.style.borderBottom = '3px solid transparent';
      panel.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }
}
</script>
```

<!-- For the section summary, use this code which puts the content into a nice, blue box to differentiate from the rest of the module content. The <li> tags </li> are what you use to make a bullet point list. -->

```{=html}
<div class="section-summary">
  <h3>3.3 Section Summary</h3>
  <ul>
    <li>Social, biological, and psychological factors can increase our risk of developing a mental illness or experiencing mental health deterioration.</li>
    <li>Some of these factors may be out of our control (i.e., genetic vulnerabilities), while others are very much within our control (i.e., nutrition, physical activity, and sleep quality).</li>
    <li>Our physical and mental health are closely related - taking care of ourselves physically can help us to maintain good mental health.</li>
  </ul>
</div>
```
